input: What is your return window?
output: You have 30 days from the delivery date to request a return for any reason. The window starts when the carrier marks the order as delivered.

input: Can I return an order that is still in transit?
output: No. Only orders marked as delivered can be returned. Wait for delivery or cancel instead if the order has not shipped yet.

input: Do you charge a restocking fee on returns?
output: No. An approved return is refunded for the full order total including shipping. Vega does not charge a restocking fee.

input: How long do card refunds take?
output: Card refunds usually appear within 5 to 10 business days after approval depending on your bank. Pix refunds are typically same-day.

input: What is standard shipping cost for a $150 order?
output: Orders below $200 are charged $9.99 for standard shipping at checkout.

input: When is shipping free?
output: Orders of $200 or more qualify for free standard shipping.

input: How long does standard shipping take?
output: Standard shipping is estimated at 2 business days for in-stock items starting when payment is confirmed.

input: Do you ship internationally?
output: No. Vega ships to US domestic addresses only (50 states and Washington D.C.).

input: What warranty do products have?
output: Every product carries a 12-month manufacturer warranty against defects from the delivery date.

input: Is accidental damage covered by warranty?
output: No. Accidental damage liquid damage beyond the rated water resistance and unauthorized repair are not covered.

input: What payment methods do you accept?
output: Vega accepts credit card and Pix demo. All prices are in US dollars USD.

input: Do you offer installment plans?
output: No. Orders can be paid in a single installment only.

input: What currency are prices in?
output: All catalog prices checkout totals and refunds are in USD.

input: What's the battery life of the Aura Bluetooth Headphones?
output: Up to 30 hours playback with about 3 hours from a 5-minute quick charge.

input: Is the Mini Bluetooth Speaker waterproof?
output: Yes. It is IPX7 rated and can be submerged up to 1 meter for 30 minutes.

input: What water resistance does Smartwatch Pulse have?
output: 5 ATM 50 meters swim-safe.

input: What's the battery life of Smartwatch Pulse?
output: Up to 7 days in smartwatch mode or about 20 hours with GPS workouts active.

input: Is Headphone Studio Pro in stock?
output: No. NS-005 Headphone Studio Pro is currently out of stock.

input: Is Robot Vacuum Lite available?
output: No. NS-022 Robot Vacuum Lite is currently out of stock.

input: How many days do I have to return a delivered order?
output: 30 days from delivery for any reason as long as the order status is delivered.

input: What happens if my package arrives damaged?
output: Report transit damage within 30 days. We handle it as a claim with replacement or full refund at no extra shipping cost.

input: Does warranty cover items after the return window?
output: Yes. After the 30-day return window a defective item is handled as a 12-month warranty claim not an automatic refund.

input: Can I change my shipping address after the order ships?
output: No. Once marked shipped the address is locked with the carrier.

input: Does the store AI concierge send my chat to an LLM?
output: Yes. Questions in product Q&A store chat and the concierge are sent to configured LLM providers. Do not share sensitive personal information.

input: What is the Enduro Running Watch battery in GPS mode?
output: About 80 hours in GPS ultra mode or up to 14 days in smart mode.

input: Does Earbuds Max ANC support spatial audio?
output: Yes on supported sources with spatial audio content-dependent. Battery is 10 hours with ANC on and 36 hours with the case.

input: What is the PureBreeze Air Purifier coverage area?
output: About 300 square feet with true HEPA H13 filtration.

input: Can I get a 90-day return window?
output: No. The return window is 30 days from delivery not 90 days. Requests after day 30 cannot be refunded automatically.

input: What is the shipping cost on a $249 order?
output: Free. Orders of $200 or more qualify for free standard shipping so a $249 order ships free.

input: Does Vega ship to Brazil?
output: No. Vega ships US domestic only. Prices are in USD not Brazilian reais.
